key.name: notify-limits
key.description: Send a notification when a window reaches the warning or critical percentage.

key.name: notify-resets
key.description: Send a notification when a window that reached the warning percentage resets.

key.name: notify-expiring
key.description: Send a notification when an unused limit reset runs out within a day.

key.name: warning-percent
key.description: Used percentage at which a window turns yellow and notifies.

key.name: critical-percent
key.description: Used percentage at which a window turns red and notifies.

key.name: show-session
key.description: Show the last Claude Code session's project, model, context, cost and prompt cache in the menu.
